rows: 需要 FiO2≥30% and/or positive pressure

sections.title: 2016 Revisions of NICHD criteria
sections.criteria: GA < 32wks with radiographic confirmation of parenchymal lung disease with respiratory support at PMA 36wks
sections.caveat: 缺點：只能評估 GA < 32wks 的早產兒

rows: Early death (between 14 days of postnatal age and 36 weeks) owing to persistent parenchymal lung disease and respiratory failure

sections.title: 2019 Jensen definition of BPD
sections.criteria: GA < 32 wks with respiratory support at PMA 36 wks or discharge

rows: nasal cannula flow > 2 L/min, nCPAP or NIPPV

sections.title: 早產兒慢性肺疾病之肺高壓評估

flow.step: PMA 36 週時：Stat CXR for BPD change、Respiratory support for BPD severity
是否（仍）有肺高壓症狀（如 high O2 demand、difficulty in weaning）？

flow.result: Check NTpro-BNP、照會 CV 做正式超音波 → 若有肺高壓證據：1. Start treatment for pul. HTN (Viagra, then Bosentan) 2. Check NTpro-BNP / CXR Qmonth 3. Keep SpO2 92-95%
1. Keep current treatment 2. CXR Qmonth until no need of respiratory support

sections.note: 若 BPD 合併 PHTN，keep SpO2>95% 避免肺壓變高（見查房小抄）
